arStrings.szText: In that you are correct, pit fighter. Your foolish errand has failed.

Many small minds have tried to chart my path for me, and for years I had no power to resist. Then Akarat saw me, taught me the language of these magnificent creatures, and bade all Skovos to give way before me.
Now you stand here with sewer mud on your boots, and would teach me the way to live? As though you were the first? You won't even be the first I kill today.
